LESSON: ATHLETICS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: PERFORMING AND DISPLAYING Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested
Topic 2.1: Athletics
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Athletics, part of PERFORMING AND DISPLAYING Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested in Grade 4 CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to maintain appropriate posture during sprints? 2. Why is the national flag flown during a national athletic event?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a virtual or live demonstration of sprint starts and sprinting techniques,

2. demonstrate a medium and elongated sprint start techniques,

3. demonstrate the sprinting technique,

4. sketch the Kenyan flag on a paper/fabric,

5. paint the flag observing colour arrangement and neatness,

6. attach the flag to a suitable handle,

7. practise the medium and elongated start,

8. practise sprinting technique,

9. run sprint races while observing safety and cheering each other using the flags made. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a virtual or live demonstration of sprint starts and sprinting techniques,
2. demonstrate a medium and elongated sprint start techniques,
3. demonstrate the sprinting technique,
4. sketch the Kenyan flag on a paper/fabric,
5. paint the flag observing colour arrangement and neatness,
6. attach the flag to a suitable handle,
7. practise the medium and elongated start,
8. practise sprinting technique,
9. run sprint races while observing safety and cheering each other using the flags made. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Athletics together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: The learner acquires a sense of belonging to their country as they paint and fly the Kenyan flag.

• Digital literacy: The learner uses digital technology to watch a virtual demonstration of sprint starts and sprinting techniques.

Values:
• Patriotism: The learner appreciates sketching and painting the Kenyan flag.

• Love: The learner works with peers to demonstrate the techniques of starting sprints and sprinting techniques.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety and security: The learner performs sprints while observing the safety of self and others.

• Social cohesion: The learner works with peers as they play sprint games while observing safety and cheering each other using

the flags.

Link to other learning areas:

Social Studies: The learner links knowledge of Kenyan flag learnt in Social Studies as they learn colours of the flag.
